Subject: Redwood discovery recap + next steps

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood to reduce inference cost for your search reranking pipeline and meet 50ms target P50 across peak loads.
- Scope we discussed: QA/test environment for a 2-week pilot (subset of traffic, read-only), run with our quantized model variant, and validate latency/cost & quality on 20k evaluation prompts.
- Success criteria: P50 latency < 50ms, no more than 8% relative ROUGE loss vs. current model, and <25% increase in cost per 1M tokens.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send a one-page SOW and a pricing estimate for the pilot (attached).
2) You’ll confirm the pilot start window and a list of 1–2 test owners.
3) Dylan (cc’d) will set up a sandbox project and share temporary credentials once we have an OK.

Attachment: redwood-pilot-sow.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Can you confirm whether the pilot is still a priority for AtlasOps this quarter and the right person to own the test on your side? Happy to hop on a quick 15-min sync if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
